name: nexttyproa
description: A Typora-like markdown note desktop app
author: nextTyproa

scripts.dev:electron: wait-on http://127.0.0.1:8080/api/health http://127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env BACKEND_PORT=8080 electron .
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend,electron -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:electron"
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.dist:verify: cd backend && mvn test && cd .. && npm run build && node scripts/verify-dist-resources.js
scripts.prepare:resources: node scripts/copy-backend-jar.js && node scripts/prepare-jre.js && npm run test:packaged
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run prepare:resources && npx electron-builder --win dir && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/package-zip.ps1
scripts.dist:setup: npm run build && npm run prepare:resources && npx electron-builder --win nsis
scripts.dist:dir: npm run build && npm run prepare:resources && npx electron-builder --win dir
scripts.dist:portable: npm run build && npm run prepare:resources && npx electron-builder --win portable
